gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-gujarati: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully in poured, uniform-width strokes, with a high mean line and an e that opens wide to the right. Anek Gujarati settles in underneath, clean and approachable.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi has big open counters in every small letter and curves that give way generously. Against Luckiest Guy's stout, pipe-cleaner strokes, it reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-kannada: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, every stroke monoline from stem to serif, with its mean line set high. Anek Kannada, a plain sans with a tall x-height, can take a larger size.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching the capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. And next to Luckiest Guy's chunky, crossbar-thick shouting, that openness is what makes the pair work.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-odia: Poured ink, one width, no thin strokes anywhere: that is Luckiest Guy. Anek Odia answers with unlatched, open rounds and capitals barely above lowercase, a sans-serif quietly steering the whole pairing.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-tamil: Strokes traced at the width of one stylus, plus a high mean line, give Luckiest Guy its loud, cheerful bounce. Anek Tamil has big round bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, so text flows along easily.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-telugu: Wide, tall bowls drive the rhythm here, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Luckiest Guy is best at being loud and cheerful with unvarying strokes; Anek Telugu, a plain sans, is best at being quietly approachable.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-arimo: Arimo is neutral and businesslike, with a tall mean line and generous gaps in its rounded letters. Luckiest Guy does the shouting in its laser-etched, constant-width strokes; Arimo, a plain sans, does the explaining.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-armata: Lines that hold their thickness: Luckiest Guy keeps that up from start to finish. Armata adds spacious gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of the letter height, making the pair's strongest quality its contrast in tone.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-athiti: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to one line width. Athiti, a sans with see-through s shapes, gives it something approachable to stand next to.
